Our Story

A Technological Pillar for Nigerian Hospitals

Digha-Biomedicals is a branch of Dighamux Nigeria Limited, incorporated in Nigeria as a Technological Innovation and Inventing Company. We measure success in solving human and medical needs — by inventing and promoting technological solutions that assist health experts to provide timely healthcare.

For over eight years, we have been a reliable, low-cost pillar to hospitals — providing ready solutions to equipment deficiencies and breakdowns. Partnering with Digha Bio-medicals means increased ROI while delivering adequate health services to the public.

Trusted by Leading Hospitals

Our Products

Radiology
500mm Static X-Ray Machine
High-frequency transformer with anode rotation. Full and sectional views available. Built for clinical environments across Nigeria.
Radiology
Portable X-Ray Unit
Mobile X-ray system for bedside and ward use. Compact, reliable, and easy to maneuver in hospital settings.
Radiological Control
DM-B3 Ray-Combiner
Precision X-ray control unit. Dual-ray switching with independent channel monitoring for advanced radiological setups.
Energy Solutions
5HP Advance Hybrid Solar Pump
Intelligent solar-grid hybrid pump controller with real-time voltage, solar input, and amperage monitoring displays.
Electronic Systems
AT-X Intel-Distribina
ISO 9001:2000 certified distribution unit with multi-channel solar and DC voltage monitoring. IER-compliant controller.
Electronics Manufacturing
Electronic Circuit Boards
Digital and analogue electronic circuit boards — designed and fabricated in-house for use in biomedical and industrial systems.
What We Do

Our Services

01
X-Ray Machine Installation
Complete supply, installation, and commissioning of X-ray machines and radiological equipment in hospital facilities across Nigeria. We handle room shielding, control panels, and cabling.
02
Equipment Repair & Maintenance
Rapid-response maintenance for biomedical equipment failures. We restore hospital operations quickly, reducing costly downtime with reliable, affordable repair solutions.
03
Biomedical Device Manufacturing
In-house design and manufacturing of biomedical equipment including X-ray controllers, hybrid solar systems, and electronic circuit boards — all ISO-certified.
04
Engineering Training & Capacity Building
Hands-on biomedical engineering training programs (75% practical) in partnership with state governments and international organizations like MedShare and Coca-Cola Foundation.
